3859b139b5.rewrite:
lea eax,[r8*4+0x0]
add rdx,rax
neg rax
mov r10,rdi
pxor xmm2,xmm2
movdqa xmm3,XMMWORD PTR [CONST_1]
movdqa xmm4,XMMWORD PTR [CONST_2]
3859b139b5.why: A 32-bit LEA computes the same wrapped, zero-extended scaling directly in eax, eliminating the copy from r8 to rax. The final value of r8 is not required.

8a0b896f43.why: Both loaded sums, the saturating pack, both clamps with arbitrary register operands, the store, and the pointer updates contribute to required outputs.

1aaa686ad1.why: All four updated registers are live, and computing the negated logical half of rdx still requires the separate shift and negation.

6a4fa9ac10.why: SSE2 needs the copy to form both byte interleavings while preserving the loaded xmm1, and both stores and the flag-producing index update are required.

90d9f8b0e8.why: The pointer results and negated logical half of rdx are all live, with no redundant scalar operation to remove.

04bc5baed5.why: Both loaded vectors, both interleavings, the final lane permutation, all stores, and the index update are required, and merging the smaller stores would need an extra permutation.

55ea17f348.why: Each instruction establishes a separate required result in one of the three vector registers or two general-purpose registers.

0fc0b8a452.why: The byte prefix sums require the SSE copies, shifts, and additions, and both intermediate vectors remain live alongside the stored and shuffled accumulator.

30c79ce2ed.why: All three vector initializations and both scalar updates are required, including the zeroed upper halves of the vector registers.

933bb295e1.why: The load is already folded into XOR and the prefix scan already uses three-operand instructions, while both intermediate vectors and the accumulator results remain live.

e12ef4b9dc.why: The three required vector values have distinct destinations and upper-half requirements, and both scalar updates are also live.

d3a6c0a934.why: The lane-local prefix scan, extracted upper lane, two stores, and successive accumulator shuffles all contribute to required results with no removable copy.

3ed914ebe5.why: All three vector zeroes, the scalar zero, and the register copy are required, and SSE4.1 has no instruction combining these independent writes.

498611eb5f.why: SSE4.1 requires separate full-width products and accumulator additions, and broadcasting the coefficient cannot use a wider memory operand than the original four-byte load.

06fdaaa96e.why: Both signed products and accumulator additions are needed, and the two four-byte loads must also establish the required final vector values.

54907085ff.why: The 32-bit scaling, pointer addition, 64-bit negation, and vector initialization each perform necessary work for live outputs.

89de5a3723.why: The three loaded pointers each need the scaled offset added, while the negated offset and vector shift count are also required outputs.

10bce63229.why: All three pointer loads, the pointer difference, and the vector shift-count initialization are required, with no disposable loaded result to fold away.

3fdaa19bd7.why: Both vector initializations, all three pointer loads and additions, and the scaled negative offset are required live results.

040d11fa20.why: All three loaded pointers contribute to live outputs, and the subtraction and vector shift-count initialization cannot be eliminated.
